summary: Keep docs linked from CLAUDE.md under 10 KB (task)
author: pm
body:
Rule d-026: every doc linked from CLAUDE.md stays under 10 KB; over that it is audited for an index split. Over the limit on 2026-11-23 (measured): `decisions.md` 12,641 B, `ccontrols-reference/core.md` 10,645 B; `tickets.md` 37,899 B is the release-text exception. Closes when its sub-tasks are done.

**Done when:** no linked doc or sidecar is over 10 KB except the recorded exceptions.

Source: user request 2026-11-23 (d-026); .claude/docs/documentation.md.

**Closed, 2026-11-24:** every sub-task is done (HH-0024 to HH-0027), and the 10 KB rule and D1 log are in place. Confidence 95%.
